subject.title: [Bug]: Repeated hard resets on same session key despite high reserveTokensFloor; retry loop re-injects bootstrap context

question: Should overflow recovery suppress or minimize bootstrap context on post-compaction retries, fail closed after bounded attempts, or keep default bootstrap injection and improve diagnostics only?
rationale: Current code can support several plausible fixes, but the choice affects existing default-configured agents, long-running task recovery, token cost, and user-visible failure behavior.

options.title: Define a minimal recovery retry policy
options.body: Adopt a maintainer-approved minimal-context post-compaction retry or circuit-breaker policy, then implement it with targeted source and live channel proof.

options.title: Split into narrower trackers
options.body: Keep this issue open but route only bootstrap reinjection to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67419 and only repeated tool-loop overflow to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78562.

options.title: Diagnostic-only for now
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and improve operator guidance while gathering live repros for the remaining recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Define a minimal recovery retry policy
recommendation.body: Adopt a maintainer-approved minimal-context post-compaction retry or circuit-breaker policy, then implement it with targeted source and live channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the current contextInjection mechanism and adjacent agent config/docs history, which makes them the best available routing candidate for the bootstrap-policy choice.
